description: HSE approval date set to the version 3 date (2026-04-13): the indication in its current wording ("Treatment of relapsed or refractory Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma") is present in v3 of the treatment regimen (the current NCCP National SACT Regimens download, R_ESHAP_v3_394.pdf) but not in v2 on 2020-12-06 (https://web.archive.org/web/20201206195121/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/lymphoma-myeloma/394-r-eshap-therapy.pdf) or v1 on 2019-07-18 (https://web.archive.org/web/20190718155203/https://www.hse.ie/eng/services/list/5/cancer/profinfo/chemoprotocols/lymphoma-myeloma/394-r-eshap-therapy.pdf), which read "Treatment of relapsed Non Hodgkin Lymphoma".
